title: Towards Identifying the Dataset Biases Causing Phantom Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Computing average dataset embeddings (Sentence BERT and word2vec) minus a clean baseline, and measuring cosine similarity to a vocabulary to detect hidden concepts related to Catholicism via regex pattern matching on the closest words.
